text:
Nora: Quick thread to nail pilot acceptance for Acme split canary. Need final pass/fail rules for batching, caching, quant and eval alerts.
Diego: High level: we want measurable econ + tight quality guardrails. My draft: 
- econ: projected monthly cost reduction >= 15% on sample traffic
- quality: primary task metric drop <= 1.25% absolute or human score delta <= 0.8/5
- latency: p50 <= 130ms, p95 <= 350ms for tail-safe route
Priya: Eval-alerts config (suggested):
```
primary_metric: "primary_task_f1"
baseline: 0.905
alert_if_drop_abs: 0.0125
evaluation_window_minutes: 60
min_eval_samples: 75
embedding_drift_warn: mean_cosine_shift > 0.018
```
Priya: Also, create a secondary golden-set check: 250 seeded prompts run daily; fail if >2% regressions.
Kyle: Ops note: batching knobs trade throughput vs p95. Recommend two canaries:
- canary-safe: max_batch_delay=6ms (aim p95 target)
- canary-econ: max_batch_delay=30ms (better throughput)
Kyle: We'll tag routes so we can compare cost/latency/quality per canary.
Nora: Quant presets: Rohit already built q8a and q4_0 variants. For pilot use q8a on safe canary, q4_0 on econ canary.
Diego: Caching policy: prefix caching for idempotent queries only. CS approval required per route. Target cache_hit >= 28% where enabled.
cs-bot: CS request: Acme must provide a list of cacheable endpoints + 300 golden prompts by EOD Thurs.
Priya: Rollout gate: proceed to broader rollout only if ALL conditions met for 48h: econ pass, quality pass, no primary alerts. Otherwise auto-pause and page on-call.
Kyle: Auto-rollback: immediate switch to baseline model variant + disable batch config if primary alert triggers twice in 12h OR golden-set fails. Runbook PR incoming.
Diego: Telemetry to collect: per-route token counts, cache hits, batch delay histogram, latency buckets, task metric, quant-perf deltas. Add experiment_id tag for each canary.
Nora: Decision: two canaries (safe + econ), acceptance gates as above, cache only on approved endpoints, auto-rollback policy.
Deploy-bot: deploy queued -> canary/acme/1761112222 (status: queued) :rocket:
Nora: Action items: @Priya (land eval config + golden set runner), @Kyle (rollback runbook + SLO docs), @Diego (cost projection + telemetry tagging), @CS (provide cache whitelist + golden prompts).
Diego: We'll reconvene 24h after canary start to review metrics.
Nora: Thanks all. I'll draft the pilot summary with these gates and share with Acme after CS whitelist confirmed. :thumbsup:
